multiplierPolicy.under20: linearly scale from 2.00x at the low end toward 1.80x as price approaches $20
multiplierPolicy.20To35: linearly scale from 1.70x at $20 toward 1.40x as price approaches $35

scope.formula: multiply each current variant price below $35 by the tiered multiplier determined by its current price
scope.compareAtPrices: multiply existing compare-at prices by the same variant multiplier; preserve absence
scope.variantPrices: preserve independent variant pricing; never flatten quality, size, color, or bundle prices
scope.status: do not change product status or sales-channel inclusion
